# Camly | High-Precision Pomodoro Engine

Camly is a professional-grade tactical utility for deep work and high-performance productivity.

## Core Capabilities
- High-Precision Pomodoro Timer: Synchronized with atomic time standards.
- Tactical Notes Engine: Capture insights with real-time AI synthesis.
- Cinematic Visual Modalities: Switch between digital chronometers and SVG hourglass visualizations.
- Enterprise-Grade Knowledge Hub: Exhaustive masterclasses on focus architecture and chronological science.

## Technical Standards
- Framework: Next.js 15 App Router
- Logic: Genkit AI Integration
- Synchronization: Real-time Firebase Firestore protocols
- UI: ShadCN & Tailwind CSS optimized for performance

## Strategic Vision
Camly aims to establish chronological sovereignty for professional performers by providing high-parity focus tools and high-authority productivity intelligence.
